note:
Alt text for the two standards photographs, in the five published non-English locales.

Shopify DOES expose file alt text as translatable, under the MEDIA_IMAGE resource type with a single `alt` key — worth knowing, because it is not obvious and the resource is the MediaImage gid rather than anything derived from the filename. The gids are recorded here; they are stable for the life of the file.

The alt describes what is VISIBLE and claims nothing. These are illustrative photographs, not documentation of Skingenetix's own supplier, and on a page about regulatory compliance an image of an inspector sits close to implying it depicts this brand's facility. No locale says 'our laboratory' or 'our factory'.

Gendered forms follow the picture: the inspector reads as a woman, so DE/FR/ES/IT use feminine forms. Dutch has no gendered form here.
